_what: Bounds of tool:check-an-archive-against-my-rules (do-work/check-an-archive.mjs). most_archive_bytes: the most compressed bytes read from the address; most_file_bytes: a file larger than this is not written; the answer names it in skipped_paths with its size, and a run where a rule covers one is not a pass, since that file was never judged (the largest text file in trillion-workshop's main was 10.6 MB on Nov 19 2026, tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json, which the earlier 4 MiB bound left unjudged while the run still passed); most_written_bytes: the most bytes all written files may hold together. Measured Nov 19 2026: trillion-workshop's main is a 57 MB archive of 25,939 files.
